go_semantics: Both trees declare go 1.22 in go.mod. The labels assume Go 1.22 language semantics and standard library, built by a Go 1.22 or later toolchain with this module as the main module.

expected_findings.defect: The loop condition `i <= len(lines)` reads `lines[len(lines)]`, so `CountMatches` panics with an index out of range on every call, including when `Tail` returns nil.
expected_findings.rationale: A slice of length k has valid indexes 0 to k-1. The loop runs k+1 times and the last iteration indexes one past the end; with nil lines the first iteration already indexes `lines[0]`.
